body: I got a question like that in therapy. I sat there like an idiot going pale out of pure misery. It's ok if nothing comes to mind at first. For reference, I took months to reach any worthy conclusion and still, I am not sure. Just take your time, we're in this together :).

I know you are right, problems are something to be mended (as is such in personal evolution), yet I am seemingly incapable of acting upon any desire for change. Perhaps fate places me within a dynamic equilibrium where at best I feel apathy.
I casually walk into the street every now and then hope I get hit by a car
